name: S&P Domain + Lead I
desc: S&P Global domain knowledge plus Lead I behavioral questions. Final round interviews test judgment and ownership, not just code.
tip: Every behavioral answer needs a CONCRETE example from your work. Generic I would answers score far below in the BMS migration I... Prepare 5 STAR stories before the interview.

r: Revenue, EPS, P/E, debt from company filings. Used for valuation and analysis.
Situation -> Task -> Action -> Result. Under 90 seconds each.
Respond with trade-offs: we can hit that date if we scope to X.
Adding source 51 should not require a code change.
Re-running the pipeline on the same data produces the same result.
Own the root cause. No blame. Concrete structural change afterward.
Deliberate and documented debt is fine. Silent debt is what kills teams.
Additive changes (new nullable columns) are backward-compatible in Parquet.
